name: Transport Corporation of India Limited
summary: Transport Corporation of India Limited provides end-to-end integrated supply chain and logistics solutions in India. The company operates through Freight Division, Supply Chain Solutions Division, Seaways Division, and Energy Division segments. It offers surface transport solutions, such as full truck load, less than truck load, over-dimensional cargo, and project heavy haul. In addition, the company provides supply chain solutions, such as supply chain network design, warehousing management, multimodal transportation, and inventory management services, as well as offers coastal shipping, container cargo movements, and transportation services.
